notes.title: Small Bugfixes #1
notes.content:
In this small patch, the link to the Discord Channel was updated. Feel free to join our Kloppyssimo Discord Channel and post your creations!
An issue Playbutton in the first Level was also fixed, as it sometimes dissapeared.

Please feel free to try out the demo and let me know If you have any suggestions or encounter any problems!
Thanks and have fun!:)
